fact: The FY2023/24 Ministerial Policy Statement for UBOS lists an Updated UBOS Act as a budget output with a target of one amended Act in 2023/24 and records a professional seminar on the UBOS Censuses and Surveys Rules of 2018 held in 2022/23.
title: Ministerial Policy Statement FY 2023/24, Vote 143 Uganda Bureau of Statistics
publisher: Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development
